items.quote: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
items.claim: The speaker says a group asked him to make gods to go before them, because they did not know what had happened to Moses, the man who brought them out of Egypt.
items.actor: they (the group quoted by the unnamed speaker)
items.action: demanded that the speaker make gods to go before them
items.mechanism: They did not know what had become of Moses, their leader.
items.place: Egypt (mentioned as the land they left; where the speech took place is not stated)
